sources.entry: SOLECTRUS - Photovoltaic dashboard that displays energy production and consumption with cost and savings calculations. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: SOLECTRUS is a self-hosted solar dashboard that shows real-time energy generation and consumption and calculates costs and savings for a photovoltaic system.
summary.what_it_does: SOLECTRUS displays real-time insights into energy generation and consumption for a PV system. It automatically calculates costs and savings so users can see how their solar installation performs. The README describes it as self-hosted, runnable on a Raspberry Pi or any Linux box. The recommended installation route is HELIOS, a companion app that sets up the Docker containers, manages configuration, and installs updates. The README also covers a local development setup on macOS using PostgreSQL, Redis, Caddy, and InfluxDB-based tests. It includes an optional, sponsor-only, read-only Model Context Protocol server that exposes data to AI clients, disabled by default.
use_cases: monitor rooftop solar production in real time
calculate electricity cost and solar savings
self-host a photovoltaic dashboard on a Raspberry Pi
ask an AI assistant questions about PV system data
how_to_run: Recommended: install via HELIOS companion app, which sets up Docker containers and manages updates
brew bundle (development on macOS, installs PostgreSQL, Redis, Caddy from Brewfile)
bin/setup (installs gems and NPM packages, creates database)
notable: Installed and updated through the HELIOS companion app, which also produces anonymized support packages
Optional read-only Model Context Protocol server for AI clients, sponsor-only
Live demo hosted on Hetzner Cloud
Trademark policy: modified versions distributed or run as a service must use a different name
caveats: Development setup instructions assume macOS with Homebrew
The MCP AI-access feature is sponsor-only and disabled by default
Trademark terms require forks that are distributed or run as a service to be renamed
